_about: The small games, one row each, for the 游戏厅 (scripts/arcade.html?dev=1 — Hanli's test page, never linked in the game) and the try page (scripts/try-game.html?dev=1&game=<id>). `id` is the module, scripts/games/<id>.js, which keeps the small-game contract (games/mount.js: `mount(container, { data, lang, reducedMotion }) → Promise<{ won, grade?, stars? }>`; a pure board module gets it from `mountPure`). `group` places it on the page; `scene` · `hui` · `task` say where the story embeds it. A new game registers here with its module; the page reads its name and how-line from the module's `meta`.
_throws: Every throw in 卷一, from the book (Hanli 2026-10-16: 「投掷类都可以换」), each its own level of 砸寨 — the one throw kit (Hanli 2026-10-20: 「射鹿可以用砸寨代替. 其他投掷类都用砸寨的不同关卡代替」; tools/zhazhai/src/data/throws.ts, a task's `deal.lv` names it): 1 第一回 00-cave 扔石听声 「先往里扔了一块石头，听了听，是空的」 — cut 2026-10-19 (the passage whole), no level; 2 第二回 00-deer 射鹿 「往左偏半寸」 — `deer-wind` (箭 ×3, the stag at the stream behind a fallen log on two stones, a dead pine leaning over it; a throw whizzing past and it bolts, comes back elsewhere); 3 古七 09-yishui 芦苇里那一等 「他扣在指间的那口短飞剑，诀一掐，放了出去」 — `yishui-reed` (短飞剑 ×3, the 鯥 pinned in the brambles on the night shoal, its hide turns a blade but for the wing root as it breathes); 4 第五回 暗河 邹青松 「左手在地上摸了一块石子，往左边黑里一丢……他一箭奔那团红光去了」 — PROPOSED, not in the story; 5 第五回 凶崖 「一箭奔面门……赤铜小盾」 — PROPOSED; 6 第八回 黑松岭 合窳 「飞剑头一下奔它的眼睛」 — PROPOSED; 7 第三回 三试 the 家丁's stone — not 小满's, no level; 8 饭桶 — its own game (fantong); 9 第一回 爹 射山鸡 — told. Ammo is only what 小满 owns there (the card law): 箭 the bow's (ARROW, no trick), 石子 (RED), 短飞剑 (YELLOW: tap, dash), 陶罐 (BLUE: split), 五雷符 (BLACK: burst).

games._about: 砸寨 — the throw kit (Hanli 10-20: 「re-skin Angry Aliens」; 「射鹿可以用砸寨代替. 其他投掷类都用砸寨的不同关卡代替」; STYLE RULING 10-19: comic, not ink). A re-skin of Angry Aliens (MIT; tools/zhazhai/, bundled into games/zhazhai/). The weasel forts `lv=1…5` (the title screen's select), and every story throw a level of its own by key (`_throws`; tools/zhazhai/src/data/throws.ts): its place painted, its target (the stag that bolts, the 鯥 whose hide turns a blade), props of wood and stone, and only the throws 小满 owns there. Story beats point here with `deal.lv` (deer-wind, yishui-reed); the 游戏厅 opens one with `&lv=<key>`. Each level is winnable by a sensible hand and not by a lazy one (tools/zhazhai/bot.mjs, tests/game-zhazhai.test.mjs).

games._levels: 拽爹上崖 on the kit (2026-10-19, Hanli: 「拽爹的也不好玩」; games.md § 割绳子 slots: 爹's rope, cut his pack free so he swings to the ledge). Written by hand and proved by games/bots/fallrope.js (plans, starPlans, the timing windows in tests/fallrope.test.mjs): 爹 hangs over the drop on two ropes (0 the pine root out over the drop, 1 the root above the slope), his pack (坠) on its strap under him. With the pack on, the swing in snags on the rock spur; strap first, then rope 0, and cut rope 1 as he comes to the end of his swing toward the cliff — he lands on the ledge (`reach` from `mouth`). The storm's gust swings him higher: the third 灵光 is only up there. `air` lets the swing carry (and keeps it from being quickened). Stone `kind`s are for the picture: ledge · wall (the cliff face) · spur.

teach.zh: 坠：爹背上那只包，拖着他往下——背带也划得断。
teach.en: Dead weight: the pack on Father's back drags him down — its strap can be cut.

games._levels: 喂饼's levels, here once (2026-10-16): the beat gets them through Look (the task's deal, look.mjs), mount() alone reads them here. World 360×440: the 饼 at `bread` hung from `vines` (anchor `at`, optional `slack`), the fox's mouth at `mouth` (`fox_flip`: facing left), `stones` (x, y, w, h, a degrees), a `gust` puff at `at` blowing `to`, an optional `piece` (a 饼角, a star), `say` the hint. Each is solved by order alone; games/bots/bread.js holds the answers.

say.zh: 饼挂在藤上。划断它。
say.en: The bread hangs from a vine. Cut it.

say.zh: 两根藤。先断哪一根？
say.en: Two vines. Which one first?

say.zh: 石板斜着。饼角在高的那头。
say.en: The slab slopes. The corner is at its high end.

say.zh: 洞口有风。点一下那团风。
say.en: Wind at the cave mouth. Tap the puff.

games._levels: Re-laid 2026-10-20 (the live hand won the 10-16 level in 5–12 s with one low swipe: both vines cut at once, the meat on the slab, one puff). Now the slab is a chute off to the side, and the meat must be swung onto it: cut the other vine first, the meat swings out on the crow's vine, then cut the crow's vine before the crow gets down (2.8 s) — any time after the swing has started (0.6 s) puts it on the chute, into the pan. A low swipe that cuts both drops the meat straight to the floor; the crow's vine first leaves it hanging over the floor on the other; waiting, the crow takes it. ★3: cut as the swing reaches its far end (1.05–1.5 s after the first cut), through the 灵光 up there. No puff. Found by a scratch search on rope.js and proved by bots/rentrope.js (plain and star plans) and a node imitation of play-human's casual hand (median 37 s, 53/60 within 90 s; the 10-16 level 9 s).

teach.zh: 乌鸦顺着藤往下爬。先断另一根，让肉荡开，再赶在它前头断它那根。
teach.en: A crow is walking down a vine. Cut the other one first so the meat swings out, then cut the crow's before it gets there.

games._levels: 气走经脉 (games/qimai.js, Hanli 10-19): the breath kit — hold to rise (吸), let go to sink (吐), a 气 bead along a meridian channel; one level a row, played in the 游戏厅 beside the breath game it may one day replace (story wiring waits for his play). The ladder (difficulty, games/bots/qimai.js proves each) is each level's `n` (not where its row sits): feather · xisui · (since 2026-10-20) tiaoshui · paobu · qianmi · faqiu · zhoutian · …, then the arcade-only chongmai · daimai · dazhoutian. A level (World 360×220, the bead at x 96; units/s): `speed`, `len`, `path` [[x, y]] the channel's middle, `width` [[x, half-width]] (≤ 36 is 窄脉), `gates` [{x, gap, y?, name}] 关窍, `xue` [{x, name}] 穴 checkpoints, `currents` [{from, to, push}] 乱流 (+ down), `waves` [{from, to, push}] 浪头, `heart` [{from, to, beat, kick}] 心跳乱流, `gold` [{from, to, amp, period, rise}] 金线 (rise 0.4: 吸四吐六), `dark` [{from, to, r}] 暗; `say` (the opening line), `book` (the book's line while it plays), `end`. `data.level` names the row's level for mount().

book.zh: 「心里数到一百二十，拿一根鸿毛搁在鼻子底下，吐气，毛不许动。」
book.en: "Count to a hundred and twenty, a feather under the nose: breathe out, and it mustn't stir."

say.zh: 按住是吸，气往上走；松开是吐，气往下沉。顺着这道长浪慢慢来。
say.en: Hold to breathe in: the qi rises. Let go: it sinks. Ride the long wave, slowly.

name.zh: 气走经脉 · 挑水上坡
name.en: Qi path · Water up the slope

games._levels: The reading cap before 入门 (2026-10-20, games.md § 读太长): 00-halfyear's winter — 「到了冬月，他挑水从四担挑到了六担，上坡不喘」, the book's carrying, under the yoke. The first 气走经脉 a player meets in the story (n 3: after the two cut 古二 levels, before 先吐): a climbing channel in three slopes, the buckets' swing as three 浪头, the vat's mouth a 关, the 金线 the even breath at the top. Live-fitted hand (bots/qimai.js HANDS.live, 24 runs): 24/24, 1.9 岔气, 39 s — 洗髓 23/24, 1.7, 38 s; 先吐 21/24, 2.8, 44 s.

book.zh: 「到了冬月，他挑水从四担挑到了六担，上坡不喘，只好装喘。」
book.en: "By the eleventh month he'd gone from four loads of water to six, and didn't get out of breath going uphill, so he had to pretend to."

say.zh: 扁担一颤一颤。上坡多吸一口，桶晃过来，稳住别松；气往肚子里沉。
say.en: The pole bounces. Uphill, take a little more in; when the buckets swing, hold steady — let the breath sink to the belly.

end.en: Six loads of water; the vat is full.

games._levels: Re-laid 2026-10-20 (back in 00-masan, the first 割绳子 in the story — Hanli 10-20 「可以, 放宽, 把那三关加进去」): the 10-19 level (puff the cake swinging, then cut) fed only on a cut within 0.4 s of the puff, a reflex — play-human's casual hand lost it 0/2 in 90 s. Now one thought at a time: cut, the 桂花糕 comes to rest on the slab, puff it off onto the 弹竹, which springs it to 马小宝's open mouth (the dog it fed until 2026-10-20 was not the book's: both ways on, he stuffs it into his own mouth). A plain cut still misses (Hanli 10-19: 「道具的风用不上」); the puff any time after it rests feeds, ★3 on the one arc (scratchpad search, proved by rope-gen playPlan at every HANDS reaction and a 0.3/1.5/3 s think; bots/tauntrope.js).

teach.zh: 弹竹：落上去，弹得比来时还高。糕停在石板上了？点那团风。
teach.en: Springy bamboo: whatever lands on it bounces higher than it came. Cake stuck on the slab? Tap the puff.

games._levels: Frozen from rope-gen.js (2026-10-16) and proved by games/bots/wayrope.js; the beat's book line and art are ropebeats.js's.

teach.zh: 灵气泡：碰到它就飘起来，点一下泡就破。
teach.en: A qi bubble: what touches it floats up. Tap it to pop.

book.zh: 「今夜就泡。疼，别喊。」浪头上别松口。
book.en: "Tonight you soak. It hurts. Don't cry out." On the wave, don't let go.

say.zh: 疼是一阵一阵的。浪头压下来，就一直吸着，别松。
say.en: The pain comes in waves. When one comes down, keep breathing in; don't let go.

end.zh: 一盆水从墨绿变成了漆黑。
end.en: The water went from green to black.

book.zh: 气沿督脉往上爬：尾闾、夹脊、玉枕。玉枕那半关，是留给他自己的。
book.en: The qi climbs the du channel: Weilü, Jiaji, Yuzhen. The last half of Yuzhen was left for him.

say.zh: 从尾闾往上爬，三关一关比一关窄，过了玉枕再从前面沉下来。
say.en: Climb from the tailbone: three passes, each narrower; past Yuzhen, sink down the front.

end.zh: 三关一通，周天转了一圈。
end.en: Three passes open; the circuit turns once.

games._was: 洛书 until 10-19 (Hanli: 「9宫格出现一次就可以了」): the 洛书 square stays at 洛书门 (00-luoshu) and in its 游戏厅 rows.

book.zh: 「你推着它们走一圈。」他便推。一股往上拱的劲从丹田里起——木、火、土、金、水，转了一圈。
book.en: "Push them round once." So he pushed. A force that pushed upwards rose from the dantian: wood, fire, earth, metal, water, round once.

say.zh: 从丹田起，推着它走一圈：木往上拱，火一跳一跳，土最沉，金细得像一根弦，水凉，会拐。
say.en: From the dantian, push it round once: wood heaves up, fire leaps, earth is the heaviest, metal thin as a bowstring, water cold, and it turns.

end.zh: 五扇门敞开着，底下长出了一块厚地。
end.en: The five doors stood open, and under them a patch of deep ground had grown.

games._levels: Frozen from rope-gen.js (2026-10-20, seed xizhu-3: tier 3, 灵气泡 and 荆棘; the wrong order swings it into the brambles) and proved by games/bots/xizhurope.js; the beat's book line and art are ropebeats.js's (the 息珠 item, the 饭桶's pot). Reading cap (Hanli 10-20): it breaks wm-kaikai → 讲堂.

teach.zh: 柴垛上的荆条：息珠碰上就碎。先断哪一根，它才不往那边荡？
teach.en: The brambles on the woodpile: touch them and the pearl breaks. Which vine first, so it doesn't swing that way?

book.zh: 「手是沟，咒是赶水的人。」一句话走一截路，八句话，正好从肩膀走到指头尖。
book.en: "The hand is the channel; the chant is the man who drives the water." Each line moves it a stretch — eight lines, shoulder to fingertip.

say.zh: 一句一步，从肩膀领到指头尖。肘弯那一截窄，落一句，气就停在半道上。末了一掐，掐在午文上。
say.en: A line a step, from the shoulder to the fingertip. The elbow is narrow; drop a line and the qi stops half-way. Last, the pinch on the wu mark.

end.zh: 「急急如律令！」掌心里滚出一颗火弹，栗子大。
end.en: "Swift as the statutes command!" A fireball rolls out of the palm, the size of a chestnut.

book.zh: 「它听见的不是你喘，是你心慌。」镜光扫过来，吐气要长要慢。
book.en: "It doesn't hear you breathe; it hears you panic." The light sweeps over — breathe out long and slow.

say.zh: 大通铺里，镜光一铺一铺照过来。气要藏得细——脉窄，一路窄到底。
say.en: In the long dormitory the light comes bunk by bunk. Keep the breath thin — the channel narrow all the way.

end.zh: 镜光过去了，牌子是凉的。
end.en: The light has passed; the token is cold.

name.en: Qi path · The back of the mountain

title.en: The back of the mountain · One foot wide

book.zh: 山路越走越窄，窄得只容得下一只脚，小满跟在后头，气也不粗。
book.en: The path got narrower and narrower, until there was room for only one foot, and Xiaoman, following behind, didn't even breathe hard.

say.zh: 跟着瞿老上后山。路一截比一截窄，到崖顶只剩一只脚宽——贴着金线走，气别粗。
say.en: Follow Elder Qu up the back of the mountain. The path narrows stretch by stretch, one foot wide at the top: ride the gold thread, keep the breath easy.

end.en: On the clifftop, a thatched hut.

book.zh: 「风，你是砍不着的。」「你得随它，跟着它走。」
book.en: "You can't cut the wind." "You have to go with it. Follow it."

say.zh: 金线就是那片叶子飘下来的路。风会掉头——随它，跟着它走。
say.en: The gold thread is the leaf's way down. The wind turns — go with it, follow it.

end.zh: 叶子正落在扫帚把尖上。
end.en: The leaf lands right on the tip of the broom.

book.zh: 每天天不亮上崖顶，站到巽那一格上，看落叶打转。他看见了它起来的那一下。
book.en: Every dawn on the Xun square, watching leaves spin. He saw the moment it rose.

say.zh: 叶子打转，风一阵一阵掉头——眼睛别跟着转。看见它起来的那一下，挪半步。
say.en: Leaves spin; the wind turns and turns — don't let the eyes spin. The moment it rises, half a step aside.

end.zh: 那片叶子贴着他的耳朵飘过去了。
end.en: The leaf floats past his ear.

book.zh: 「背后有风，脚下有路。」迎着风，往后退了一步——一滑便是十丈；逆着风，「噗」，又「噗」。
book.en: "Wind at your back, road at your feet." Facing the wind, a step back — ten zhang in one glide; against it, pff, and pff again.

say.zh: 灌一丝灵力进鞋，脚后跟的「鳃」一张一合。贴着地滑，离地不过一尺。北风一阵一阵掉头——逆着它，「鳃」只「噗」一声：三处「噗」是窄口，顺着风穿过去。
say.en: A thread of qi into the boots; the gills at the heels open and close. Glide low, a foot off the ground. The north wind turns and turns — against it the gills only go pff: three pff-narrows to thread with the wind at your back.

end.zh: 一滑十丈，到了墙根底下才停住。
end.en: Ten zhang in a glide, and he stops only at the foot of the wall.

name.zh: 气走经脉 · 边跑边念

games._levels: The reading cap before 入门 (2026-10-20, games.md § 读太长): 今一's first week — the dawn run on the outside lane, 「边跑边能说整句话——这是规矩」, reciting the twelve channels, 雷老师's 「念得出整句，就是速度对了」. The 金线 is the talking pace, most of the lap (tol 9, 65 per cent); the 穴 are the channels he can say (手太阴 · 手阳明 · 足阳明), then 「足……足……」, a narrow stretch (32) with a surge where the fourth won't come. n 4, between 挑水 and 先吐. Live-fitted hand: 24/24, 2.7 岔气, 40 s; sloppy 11/12.

book.zh: 「念得出整句，就是速度对了。接着念。」
book.en: "If you can get whole sentences out, you're at the right speed. Keep reciting."

say.zh: 最外道，二十分钟。边跑边念十二正经——喘不过来，就念不成句。
say.en: The outside lane, twenty minutes. Recite the twelve channels as you run — out of breath, and the line won't come.

end.zh: 「念得出整句，就是速度对了。接着念。」
end.en: "If you can get whole sentences out, you're at the right speed. Keep reciting."

book.zh: 喘得又快又浅，一半是白喘。先吐，再吸。
book.en: Quick shallow pants are half wasted. Out first, then in.

say.zh: 跑起来了，气道一阵窄一阵宽。窄的地方，一口别吸满。
say.en: Running now; the airway narrows and opens. Where it narrows, never a full breath.

book.zh: 「吸是踩油门，吐是踩刹车。吐得比吸的长，心就慢一截。」
book.en: "In is the throttle, out is the brake. Out longer than in, and the heart slows."

say.zh: 心跳一百四十一。吸四吐六——贴着金线走。
say.en: Heart at a hundred and forty-one. In for four, out for six — ride the gold thread.

name.zh: 气走经脉 · 黑地十一步
name.en: Qi path · Eleven steps in the dark

book.zh: 「小宝哥。跟着我喘。吐得比吸的长。」
book.en: "Xiaobao. Breathe with me. Out longer than in."

say.zh: 九点整，灯灭了。脉一折一折地拐，只看得见眼前一小圈——记住它往哪拐。
say.en: Nine o'clock, the lights go. The channel switches back and forth; you see only a small round — remember where it bends.

end.en: "… My hands aren't numb any more."

name.zh: 气走经脉 · 最后一罚
name.en: Qi path · The last free throw

book.zh: 惧是油门，长吐是刹车——刹得住一截，刹不干净。带着怕投。
book.en: Fear is the throttle, a long breath out the brake: it slows, never stops. Shoot with the fear.

say.zh: 零点六秒，落后一分。看台在喊「百分之一！」心跳没有准点。
say.en: Point six seconds, one behind. The stand chants "One per cent!" The heart keeps no time.

games._how: 喂饭桶's feed on its turn (fantong.json `puzzle.games`; Hanli 2026-10-16, 烙饼 out of the story): a 40 s round at 娘's 鏊子, two to four flatbreads browning at their own pace — tap to turn when the underside is golden, tap again to take it off when both are; wood in the stove mouth cooks faster. 8 golden meets the quota; stars by golden and bad; short of it, another batch. Alone it plays one round.

喂饭桶's feed (古四 on, the 物品 panel's 饭桶): the thing he chose hung on vines over the 饭桶, a level made each feed from the day's seed (rope-gen.js) and proved solvable before it is shown; alone it plays a sample day (`level` 1–5: tier 0–4 with the elements of that many days).

games._data: 画猜 (games/drawguess.js; Hanli 2026-10-16: 「玩家画AI猜, 试一下吧」; into the story 10-19: 「ai游戏放到游戏中吧, 还挺好玩的. 但要结合剧情」, 「秘境里也放一个. AI猜都是Yinyue猜」). `words`: things from 卷一 to draw in the 游戏厅; `also` · `en` · `enAlso` are the spellings a guess is right under, checked page-side (drawguess-rules.js matches: exact after normalize, never a substring). In the 游戏厅 the guesser is Ling, or 银月 once the save has met her; in the story always 银月, and only while she is awake and on her own line (rules). `sets.jiaxin`: 第六回's 家信 (task jiaxin-letter; the row below): each `line` is the book's own line of his letter, `word` the picture beside it, for 娘 cannot read — a line counts as written once she names it, and in words only when she does not. `met`: 本王考考你's words (rules/kao.mjs), each open once the save has passed `after` (a scene) or has `cast` (a beast walking with him). `mijing`: a 秘境 奇遇's words (rules/qiyu.mjs, worlds/jiuding/qiyu.json).

jiaxin._about: His first letter home (wm-jiaxin; the book's passage untouched, these are its own lines). 娘 cannot read, so beside a line he draws what it is about: a basin for the seventeen under the leaking roof, 爹's bow for the line about 爹, the moon over the mountain for 「我在这里很好」 — the same moon over home.

line.zh: 盆可以收起来了，十七个都收。
line.en: You can put the basins away now, all seventeen.

line.zh: 给我爹买一副护膝，狗皮的。
line.en: Buy Pa a pair of knee pads, dogskin.

data.context: 腊八夜里，大通铺上，小满就着月光给家里写第一封信。娘不识字，他在每句旁边画一样东西

games._story: 第六回's 家信 (Hanli 10-19): the board the story plays at wm-jiaxin — the row above's `data.sets.jiaxin`, 银月 guessing.

book.zh: 冲脉直上直下，浪头和乱流挤在一条道上。
book.en: The thoroughfare runs straight up and down; waves and currents crowd one road.

say.zh: 浪头、转向的乱流、关口，一样一样来。
say.en: Waves, turning currents, passes — one after another.

book.zh: 带脉横着绕腰一圈，黑里走，心还在跳。
book.en: The girdle runs round the waist — through the dark, with the heart still pounding.

say.zh: 窄、暗、心跳，风还掉头。别慌，吐得比吸的长。
say.en: Narrow, dark, a racing heart, a turning wind. Don't panic; out longer than in.

end.zh: 带脉绕了一圈，回到了原处。
end.en: Round the girdle, and back where it began.

book.zh: 小周天转熟了，气才走得了大周天——什么都会碰上。
book.en: Only once the small circuit is easy can the qi go the great one — and meet everything.

say.zh: 一口气走完全身。前面什么都有，岔了气也只回到上一关。
say.en: One breath through the whole body. Everything lies ahead; a broken breath goes back only to the last pass.

end.zh: 大周天转了一圈，浑身通透。
end.en: The great circuit turns once; the whole body clears.

games._about: 撒豆成兵 — the crowd run, a 塔防-family level type, a prototype (Hanli 10-20: 「对, 做一个撒豆成兵的关卡」; the genre: crowd + math gates, Count Masters / Mob Control; the bar: 《向僵尸开炮》). Portrait, one hand: drag left/right (A/D, ←/→) steers 小满's bean soldiers up the 山道 through 符门 gates (+ × good, − ÷ traps), past hazards and bean pickups, through the 兽潮 hordes (crowds cancel out) to 合窳; stars by soldiers left. The lead-in and countdown start it by themselves. The engine: games/sadou/core.js; the play: games/sadou/sadou.min.mjs (Phaser, tools/sadou/); the level: worlds/jiuding/levels/sadou.json.

守墙关 — wall defense, the 塔防 kit's second level type, a prototype (Hanli 10-20: 「可否加一个类似这个的关卡, 让塔防多样性」, 「做原型吧」; the bar: 《向僵尸开炮》, 「做的漂亮, 好看, 好玩」). Portrait: beasts pour down the 山道 at 沉鼎观's 山门 in waves; 小满 casts from the wall, 银月 beside him; after each wave the player picks 1 of 3 cards (剑阵 · 火符 · 寒符 · 雷符 · 银月, the 守炉 kit as skills); a tap on a beast focuses it. The first wave comes on a countdown with the lead-in, never a tap. Stars from the wall left. Phaser on the shared scripts/vendor/phaser.min.mjs (tools/shouqiang/ → games/shouqiang/shouqiang.min.mjs); the engine games/shouqiang/core.js; the level, waves and cards: worlds/jiuding/levels/shouqiang.json; the bots: tests/game-shouqiang.test.mjs. Not placed in the story yet: after Hanli plays it.

守炉 — tower defense, the 游戏厅's main game (Hanli 10-20: 「塔防这个好玩, 可以作为主力游戏」, 「不用artifact, 直接放到游戏大厅里」, 「多加几关」). 小满 lays talismans (剑阵 · 火符 · 寒符 · 雷符) by the road; 银月 is the hero (tap her, then a place: she holds two ground beasts, bites, howls to stun). Waves come on a countdown, never by a tap (calling one early pays 灵石). The engine and its tuning: games/shoulu/core.js; the painting: games/shoulu/draw.js; the balance sim: tests/game-shoulu.test.mjs. `lv=<1…5>` opens one level straight away; without it, the level select (stars kept in this browser, `lingjing.shoulu.stars`, never the save). Code-drawn art is a stopgap: small games go comic.
games._levels: One row a level, in the order they climb; each brings exactly one new thing (`new`: the beast, and the talisman that answers it). `story`: null for the 游戏厅's own levels; a story level later names its scene. `place`: the places/ id it stands in. `towers`: the talismans it allows; `unlock`: {tower: wave} — one opens only from that wave. `money`: 灵石 at the start. `hpMul`: every beast's hp × this (the level's toughness; each wave also adds 12%). `difficulty` (default 1): the knob — beasts' hp and each group's count × the level's `difficulty` × this row's `difficulty` (a boss stays one); tuned at 1 for a human-like player (core.js `human`: a sensible plan, 1–2 s late, 银月 moved now and then), not the perfect bots, since no open-source game's players have proven this balance (Hanli 10-20). `lead`: the lead-in lines, shown while the first countdown runs (`big`: the 兽潮来袭 banner). `road`: the beasts' road, [x, y] on a 600×760 board, from off the edge to the furnace; `furnace`: [x, y]; `air`: where fliers start (they fly straight at the furnace). `spots`: the build spots (40–95 off the road). `hero`: 银月 — `at`, her post [x, y]; `hair`, the 狐毛 charges the story has given her (古五 on; 0 in the 游戏厅 levels but the last). `waves`: one list a wave of [beast, count, gap s, delay s].

lead.zh: 秋收后，石坳村家家烙饼。
lead.en: After the harvest, every house in Shi'ao bakes flatbread.

lead.zh: 饼香飘上蒙山，野猪下山了。
lead.en: The smell drifts up Mount Meng. The boars come down.

lead.zh: 爹还在山里，灶火交给小满。
lead.en: Father is still in the hills. The hearth is Xiaoman's.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 成群的，火符一烧一片。
lead.en: A herd? One fire talisman burns the lot.

lead.zh: 银月：野猪而已，山道交给我。
lead.en: Yinyue: Only boars. Leave the road to me.

name.en: The path up · the incense burner

lead.zh: 上山路，沟深草密。
lead.en: The path up: deep gullies, thick grass.

lead.zh: 草里窜出一团红毛——狰！
lead.en: A ball of red fur shoots out of the grass: a zheng!

lead.zh: 它太快，银月拦不住，火符也难沾身。
lead.en: Too quick for Yinyue to hold, too quick for fire to catch.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 寒符冻住它，火才落得上。
lead.en: Frost holds it still; then the fire lands.

name.en: The herb garden · the herb stove

lead.zh: 夜里，药园里「咔嚓、咔嚓」。
lead.en: At night, in the herb garden: crunch, crunch.

lead.zh: 犰狳来啃灵草了。见人则眠，一身硬甲。
lead.en: Qiuyu at the spirit herbs. They play dead, and their hides are hard.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 剑阵砍不进，火符烧得透。
lead.en: Swords glance off. Fire gets through.

name.en: The back hill · the furnace room

lead.zh: 后山崖顶，白头的鸟一群群飞起来。
lead.en: Off the back-hill cliff, white-headed birds rise in flocks.

lead.zh: 鬿雀：鼠足虎爪，不走山道，直扑丹炉。
lead.en: Qique: rat's feet, tiger's claws. They skip the road and dive at the furnace.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 火符够不着天上。剑阵够得着；第三波起，雷符也够得着。
lead.en: Fire can't reach the sky. Swords can; from the third wave, thunder too.

name.en: Black Pine Ridge · the ninefold pill

lead.zh: 黑松岭，路会自己打结。
lead.en: On Black Pine Ridge the road ties itself in knots.

lead.zh: 九转丹在炉里，还差四十九息。
lead.en: The ninefold pill is in the furnace. Forty-nine breaths to go.

lead.zh: 林子深处，有娃娃在哭——
lead.en: Deep in the pines, a baby is crying—

lead.zh: 合窳：人面，猪身，赤尾如火。
lead.en: A heyu: a man's face, a pig's body, a tail red as fire.

lead.zh: 兽潮来袭！
lead.en: Here they come!

lead.zh: 它一哭，护体灵光便薄一层：那时打！
lead.en: When it wails, its shield of light thins: strike then!
